image_contract.storage: Image record; iPhone and Android folders separated
image_contract.representation: Processed/masked smartphone skin-site images, not guaranteed full-face/original JPEGs
image_contract.image_source_reference: MEASUREMENT.MEASUREMENT_SOURCE_VALUE documents original image path for extracted image features
image_contract.image_preprocessing: Authors describe largest contour above median grayscale brightness, mask, RGB/LCH mean and SD; this is apparent pixel color, not instrument supervision

identity_contract.visit: VISIT_OCCURRENCE; one admission per person according to documentation
identity_contract.capture_session: No explicit independent capture/session key verified; visit is not automatically equivalent to unique capture
identity_contract.join_constraints: Use person_id + visit_occurrence_id + exact anatomical site + instrument + measurement time/acquisition when present. Never nearest-join across sites or visits; reject ambiguous multiple matches.

excluded_images: Ventral finger/palm/toe images omitted for biometric privacy; derived features may remain. A feature row does not prove image availability.

instrument_contract.table: MEASUREMENT, linked through CONCEPT for non-standard concepts
instrument_contract.value: value_as_number, unit_concept_id; exact Lab component concepts must be checked in released CONCEPT
instrument_contract.units: CIE L*, a*, b* coordinate values are distinct from RGB, LCH, MST and clinical EHR values. Actual unit mapping not yet received.
instrument_contract.illuminant_observer: UNVERIFIED_PER_INSTRUMENT_RELEASE_CONFIGURATION; do not impose MSKCC D65/10 or convert D65/2 to10 without spectra/justification
instrument_contract.repeat_rule: Preserve independent readings as separate acquisition records; no averaging until repetition identifiers and conventions are verified

forbidden_targets: Image RGB or derived image Lab/LCH used as instrument ground truth
Mixing different instruments/illuminants/observers in one undifferentiated regression target
first_import_checks: Decode exact image filename/folder identity and device mapping
Require one unambiguous person/visit/site/acquisition link for each image
Collect L/a/b only from same actual instrument/acquisition
Verify unit and observer/illuminant from released metadata or author clarification
Reject incomplete/duplicate/ambiguous pairs rather than guessing
Count unique people/sites/captures/devices and missing images before splitting
usable_for_now: Documentation only; no instrument-labelled training signal acquired
potential_use_after_access: Site-matched smartphone/instrument calibration or camera-transfer supervision; forehead crops do not establish full-face selfie validation
required_owner_action: PhysioNet credentialing + accepted CITI Data or Specimens Only Research training + project DUA, performed by the owner in their own account. Do not send credentials in chat.

rights.dataset: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data License 1.5.0; qualified researcher restricted access and no sharing access
rights.tutorial_code: MIT; this does not license participant data
